invariant: A parity mechanism is accepted only when its independent latest checker record names at least two valid Java-success held-outs spanning at least two axes and each held-out passes the shipped no-oracle renderer; rejected reviews and invalid-syntax controls remain preserved evidence but never count as accepted parity.
causal_divergence: The evidence corpus has evolved several field aliases and verdict spellings under schema_version 1, while the guard validates one early concrete JSON shape. Independently, parity_perturbations recursively executes every preserved .puml as a valid positive case. That conflates record serialization with evidence semantics and makes the required preservation of rejected counterexamples and Java-error controls permanently fail the standing gate. PlantUML's SourceStringReader distinguishes a rendered diagram from PSystemError output; the Rust gate currently discards that distinction after artifacts are checked in.
planned_change: Introduce a closed normalization layer for the known schema_version 1 aliases, then validate one semantic model: pending accounts are complete but non-accepting, rejected latest reviews are valid non-accepting evidence, and accepted latest reviews must declare two Java-success passing held-outs across two axes. Build the perturbation execution manifest from those accepted declarations instead of recursively walking every preserved source. Preserve and integrity-check invalid controls separately. Document one canonical record shape for all new reviews. Make the decimal-literal ratchet bidirectional without changing its frozen baseline, and leave the error-golden census, marker set, comparator slack, park list, and allow-lists unchanged.
perturbation_axes: accepted latest review versus rejected latest review versus pending account
valid Java-success held-out versus Java-error negative control
legacy field aliases and verdict spellings versus the canonical future schema
unreferenced preserved artifact versus review-declared executable evidence
scope_boundary: This changes only evidence interpretation and test selection. It does not change SVG comparison, parser or renderer behavior, golden classification, the frozen error census, GEOM_EPS, park lists, or any shipping crate.
forbidden_approaches: accept arbitrary verdict text or infer acceptance from a truthy field
count Java error pages or invalid controls as valid perturbation passes
require rejected mechanisms to be rewritten as accepted
update the error-golden census from the dirty golden submodule worktree
add open-ended compatibility aliases without a schema-version change
acceptance: Historical accepted, rejected, and pending records normalize without changing their authored verdicts.
Only latest accepted reviews contribute executable positive held-outs, and each contributes at least two valid passing sources over two axes.
Rejected counterexamples and invalid controls remain checked in and auditable but do not make parity_perturbations fail merely by existing.
A malformed accepted review or a diverging accepted held-out fails the gate.
The decimal-literal ratchet reports both growth and uncommitted decreases; its baseline update is a separate provenance audit.
The committed golden corpus still reports the frozen 1,199 error pages.
